第一卷 第643章 我已经有人选了（第1页）
“而且，倾越还说她还没正式离婚……”
“如果她真的结婚了，那她和郁默勋之间又是怎么回事？她这是还没正式离婚，就和郁默勋搞上了？和郁默勋搞上就算了，她还吊着倾越，甚至去搞林芜的男朋友，卧槽，她够野的啊，胆子也不是一般的大！”
任戟风沉着脸，也看向了容辞那边，冷冷说道：“她可并不止胆子大这么简单。”
姚新博顺着他的视线看过去，即使他没有上前细听，都能感觉得出来陆博士对她的欣赏和喜欢，也能感觉得出来，除了陆博士以外，ai圈的其他学术大佬，对容辞的能力也非常认可。
容辞一个本科生，挤掉林芜这样的海归博士，短短一两年时间，就一跃成为ai圈一颗极其耀眼的新星，林芜跟她比起来，简直是查无此人，现在她的声望甚至还有超越郁默勋的意思……
看到容辞现在已经俨然一副ai圈大佬的架势，姚新博越看越心惊。
容辞确实不止行为够野，野心也不是一般的大。
现在不管是学术圈，还是商业圈，都对容辞非常认可，这些学术大佬和企业家都主动上去跟容辞交流。
林芜呢？明明学历能力，都高出容辞一截，却根本没什么人搭理她。
姚新博忍不住说道：“容辞踩着她上位，现在她们在圈子里地位差距这么大，说实话，我都替林芜感到憋屈。更何况，容辞还在她不知道的时候，勾引了她男朋友。之前她为了救封庭深，连命都不要了，却换来这样的结果，我的天……”
别说任戟风了，他都要心疼林芜了。
姚新博说道：“这个容辞，踩着别人上位，轻松让自己应得声望和权力的同时，还能在几个男人之间自如周旋，真不是一般的有手段。也是真的人不可貌相啊！”
他之前怎么会觉得容辞温柔内敛，是那种傻傻的非常好骗的女生呢？
想到这，姚新博有些担心了，“我们，应该可以把倾越换回来吧？”
别说姚新博了，任戟风现在都有些担心了。
不过，随后他又放宽心了些，“我们要相信倾越。”
陆博士关心完了容辞，心下已经有了决定，在跟其他人寒暄一番后，走向了不远处的封庭深和林芜。

在其他人走开一些后，陆博士顿了顿，看向了林芜。
林芜能感觉到，陆博士不是一般的喜欢容辞，但她并没有多想，然而，这一刻，看到陆博士看过来的眼神，林芜心口一突。
她还没来得及反应，陆博士就已经开口了，“抱歉林小姐，我已经有了亲传学生的人选了，这一点，在今天之前，我其实就已经有了想法，只是这种想法之前没有明确下来。但我现在已经确定了。晚点我会亲自上台宣布这件事，所以，对你，我很抱歉。不过，如果林小姐你想进来我们学院学习，我还是非常欢迎的。”
林芜脸色在陆博士开口时，就已经在瞬间变白。
但她还没来得及开口，忽然就有一个声音插了进来。
“陆博士，你口中的亲传学生的人选，是容辞吗？”

Volume 1 Chapter 643 I already have a candidate (Page 1)
"Moreover, Qingyue also said that she has not officially divorced yet..."
"If she is really married, what's going on between her and Yu Moxun? Is she getting involved with Yu Moxun before she's officially divorced? Even if she gets involved with Yu Moxun, she's still hanging on to Qingyue and even going to have sex with Lin Wu's boyfriend. Damn it, she's wild enough and her courage is not ordinary!"
Ren Jifeng had a stern look on his face, and looked at Rong Ci, and said coldly: "She is not just brave."
Yao Xinbo followed his line of sight and looked over. Even if he didn't step forward to listen carefully, he could feel Dr. Lu's appreciation and liking for her. He could also feel that in addition to Dr. Lu, other academic leaders in the AI ​​circle also recognized Rong Ci's abilities.
Rong Ci, an undergraduate student, pushed out returnee Ph.D.s like Lin Wu. In just one or two years, she became an extremely dazzling new star in the AI ​​circle. Compared with her, Lin Wu is simply unmatched. Now her reputation even means surpassing Yu Moxun...
Seeing that Rong Ci was now acting like a big shot in the AI industry, Yao Xinbo became more and more frightened.
Rong Ci is indeed not only wild in his behavior, but also extremely ambitious.
Nowadays, both the academic and business circles have great recognition of Rongci. These academic leaders and entrepreneurs have taken the initiative to communicate with Rongci.
Where is Lin Wu? Even though her academic qualifications and abilities were much higher than her, no one paid any attention to her.
Yao Xinbo couldn't help but said: "Rong Ci stepped on her to get the upper hand. Now there is such a big gap in their status in the circle. To be honest, I feel aggrieved for Lin Wu. What's more, Rong Ci seduced her boyfriend when she didn't know it. She even risked her life to save Feng Tingshen before, but she got this result, my God..."
Not to mention Ren Jifeng, he felt sorry for Lin Wu.
Yao Xinbo said: "This Rong Ci, stepping on others to get the position, easily getting the prestige and power he deserves, and at the same time being able to deal with several men freely, is really not an ordinary means. It is also true that people should not be judged by their appearance!"
Why did he think before that Rong Ci was gentle and reserved, the kind of silly girl who was easy to trick?
Thinking of this, Yao Xinbo became a little worried, "We should be able to change Qingyue back, right?"
Not to mention Yao Xinbo, Ren Jifeng was a little worried now.
However, he then relaxed a little and said, "We have to believe in Qingyue."
Dr. Lu finished caring about Rong Ci and already made a decision in his mind. After greeting others, he walked towards Feng Tingshen and Lin Wu not far away.
After the others walked away, Dr. Lu paused and looked at Lin Wu.
Lin Wu could feel that Dr. Lu didn't like Rong Ci in general, but she didn't think much about it. However, at this moment, seeing the look in Dr. Lu's eyes, Lin Wu felt something in her heart.
Before she had time to respond, Dr. Lu had already spoken, "Sorry Miss Lin, I already have a candidate for a direct student. I actually had an idea about this before today, but it was not clear before. But I have decided it now. I will go on stage to announce this in person later, so I am very sorry to you. However, if you want to come to our college to study, Miss Lin, I am still very welcome."
Lin Wu's face turned pale in an instant when Dr. Lu spoke.
But before she could speak, a voice suddenly interrupted.
"Dr. Lu, is Rong Ci the candidate you mentioned as your direct student?"
